segments.normalizedSource: ```swift struct RandomnessMonitor { let randomnessSource: UnreliableRandomGenerator var results: [Result<Int, Error>] = [] init(generator: UnreliableRandomGenerator) { randomnessSource = generator } mutating func sample() { let sample = Result { try randomnessSource.random() } results.append(sample) } func summary() -> (Double, Double) { let totals = results.reduce((sum: 0, count: 0)) { total, sample in switch sample { case .success(let number): return (total.sum + number, total.count) case .failure: return (total.sum, total.count + 1) } } return ( average: Double(totals.sum) / Double(results.count - totals.count), failureRate: Double(totals.count) / Double(results.count) ) } } ```
